comparison_scope: Same-main whole-server warm local Debug comparison, old/new then new/old, shared host, no task-owned build/E2E/cleanup overlap. Seven samples per source-refinement and rare-term shape; three per other point/order. Synthetic real Parquet. No Release, cloud, empty-cache or archive-scale qualification.
